They are drawn here from small values of both signs and the extremes (signed compares, plain add/sub: wrap-around is not a fault), and the value +0 from the same set (items_0053dc57 still overrides the top byte 0x81e4fb), so both the clamp (jle not taken) and the floor (jge not taken) occur.
